description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Transmission and Transfer Case Shifter Repair Kit for 86-89 model Samurai™s that use the smaller 10mm Locating Bolt.
This kit addresses all the common problems that cause the shift levers to bind or drag.
This is the only kit that repairs all aspects of the Transfer Case shifting mechanism.
Repairs both the Transmission and Transfer Case Shift Levers.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Transmission Shift Repair Kit
Qty 1 – Locating Bolt (Small)
Qty 1 – Transfer Case Shift Repair Kit
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1989 All Models
